'''Obridagar's Simulator Palace''' was a location on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where individuals could use [[Flight simulator/Legends|flight simulators]]. In [[44 ABY]], [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Drikl Lecersen]] and other members of his [[Lecersen Conspiracy|conspiracy]] to create a new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] met there in disguise.
